children: Mistras Group has agreed to be acquired by affiliates of alternative investment firm H.I.G. Capital for $866 million, including debt.
Shareholders of the industrial asset integrity and laboratory testing solutions will receive $20.35 a share in cash for each share they own, the company said Friday.

The price represents a premium of about 8% and 13% to Mistras' 30 and 90-day volume-weighted average share price for the period ended Sept. 17. Shares have been enjoying a strong run in 2026, trading up about 57% since the start of the year to close Thursday at $19.84. The stock has doubled over the last 52 weeks.

The transaction is expected to close later this year or early in 2027, and will require approval by the company's shareholders. The agreement also includes a 40-day "go-shop" period in which Mistras can actively solicit other bids.
H.I.G. affiliates so far have the support of holders of about 31% of the total stock.
Mistras shares were up 3% to $20.50 in premarket trading.
